Maria (CS): Heads up — Panacea spike in token usage overnight, ~3x. Need quick QBR prep impact analysis and any short-term throttles.
Jake (AE): Renewal in 8w, target $75k. We should aim to cut 10% cost guidance for QBR.
Anita (FinOps): Preliminary: embeddings + rerank are 70% of the increase. If trend continues monthly jump from $48k -> $120k. I'll model scenarios.
Ravi (SE): Quick mitigations: limit embedding context window, enable KV prefix cache, switch to quantized model variant for non-critical routes. Can add dashboard tag filter for import jobs.
Lina (Customer): We kicked off a large data import last night for onboarding — that likely explains most of it. Sorry, missed flagging.
Maria (CS): Ok — separate import traffic from organic. @Ravi can you add a filter for tag=import_job and create a short-lived alert?
Ravi (SE): Done. Alert rule sketched and applied to prod dashboards. Also recommending a 50% rate cap on bulk-embed endpoint while import runs.
Anita (FinOps): Please run two what-if forecasts by EOD: (A) import proceeds + embeddings throttled 50% (B) import postponed. Show impact to next invoice and commit runway.
Jake (AE): We can offer a 60-day runway extension with a mid-quarter commit review if they need breathing room. I'll draft QBR talking points.
Lina (Customer): We can postpone the import to next Tue 03:00 UTC to avoid surge during the quarter close.
Maria (CS): Action items: Ravi: filter+alert + PR for rate-limit; Anita: scenario numbers (EOD); Jake: commit extension language (tomorrow); Ravi/docs: add batching+retry example. Marking onboarding checklist blocked until confirm.
onboard-bot: Reminder: Panacea onboarding checklist item 'data-import-notify' still open.
Maria (CS): Will reconvene after Anita posts numbers. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
